# [CLUB NAME] Privacy Policy

Effective [EFFECTIVE DATE].

This policy is from [CLUB LEGAL NAME] ("the club", "we", "us"), of [CLUB ADDRESS]. It says what we do with your
information when you use the club's app at [MEMBERS' APP ADDRESS], book with us, or are a member of the club.

Our app runs on openPadel, open-source club software. [IF THE CLUB IS ON KUMI, THE HOSTED SERVICE: Kumi (kumi.club) runs it for
us, and handles your information only for us, as we tell it to.] [IF THE CLUB RUNS ITS OWN SERVER: it runs on a
server the club controls, at [HOSTING PROVIDER].]

## What we collect

**What you give us**
- your name, email address and the language you use the app in;
- your mobile number, if you add one (to sign in by text, or to get texts);
- your birth year, if you give it [OR IF THE CLUB ASKS FOR IT, SAY WHY];
- for your children, if you add them to your family: each child's name and birth year;
- what you book and sign up for: courts, open matches, lessons, clinics, programs and memberships;
- your payments and refunds: amounts and what they were for;
- your answers about texts and club news, and the waiver you accepted, each with the time and the wording;
- what you write to the club in the app, and the questions you ask it;
- what you write in a game's chat [IF THE CLUB HAS CHATS ON], and what you report to the club from one;
- your friends in the app, and the parents you share your family with.

**What the app records as you use it**
- your level and your game results, and the reasons your level changed;
- your sign-ins: passkeys and authenticator apps you set up, and the browser or device each session came from;
- the devices you turn notifications on for;
- what the club changed for you (a booking moved, a refund), and by whom.

**What we don't collect**
- **Card numbers.** You type your card into Stripe's own form. It goes straight from your browser to Stripe, never
  through the club's app. We see only the card's brand and last four digits.
- **Tracking.** The app has no advertising, no analytics service and no tracking across other websites. Its only
  cookie keeps you signed in, and it remembers on your device if you put off a reminder. Your IP address is used for a short time to stop too many sign-in attempts, and isn't
  kept with your account.
- **Anything from young children directly.** A child under 13 has no login: a parent adds them with a name and a
  birth year, and does everything for them (see Children, below).

## What we use it for

- to run your bookings, places, lessons, programs and membership, and take and refund your payments;
- to tell you what you need to know: a place offered to you, a booking or class we cancelled or moved, a payment, a
  receipt;
- to keep levels fair and help you find games at your level;
- to answer your questions, and to keep the club's app and your account safe;
- to send you club news by email, **only if you said yes**;
- to keep the club's books, and because the law requires it.

We don't sell your information, and we don't share it for advertising.

## Texts

[KEEP THIS PART IF THE CLUB SENDS TEXTS.]

- **Only if you say yes.** In the app (Profile, Texts) you confirm your mobile number with a code we text you, then
  tick a box that says what we'll text. Nothing is ticked for you.
- **What we text:** a place that opened up for you and must be taken by a deadline, a booking or class the club
  cancelled or moved, and codes you ask for to confirm your number or sign in. **We never send marketing or club
  news by text.** How often varies with what you book.
- **Message and data rates may apply,** depending on your mobile plan.
- **Reply STOP** to any text to stop all texts from us. **Reply HELP** for the club's name and how to reach us. You
  can also turn texts off in the app, or contact us at [CONTACT EMAIL] or [CLUB PHONE].
- **Your mobile number and your yes to texts are never shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or
  promotional purposes.** We share them only with Twilio, which sends our texts for us (below).
- Carriers aren't liable for texts that are late or don't arrive.

## Email

- Emails about your own bookings, places, payments and account come whenever there's something to tell you.
  Confirmations, being taken off something, and anything about money go straight away; the rest wait out the night
  (9 pm to 8 am, the club's time).
- **Club news** (events, offers, what's new) comes only if you said yes, and each one has a link to stop.
- If email to your address keeps bouncing, or you mark our email as spam, we stop emailing that address and the app
  asks you to check it. Messages still reach you in the app.

## Who sees your information

**At the club:** the staff who need it. Front desk and coaches see what they need to run bookings and classes;
the owner and managers see more. Everything a staff member changes is recorded. [IF HOSTED: openPadel's people come into
the club's app only when the club's owner lets them in for a set time, and everything they do is recorded for the
owner.]

**Other members** see your name where it makes sense: in open matches you join or host, the club's level lists and
results, and your friends in the app. [IF THE CLUB HAS CHATS ON: The players in a game you play in (a court booking
you're named on, an open match, a clinic or social date) read what you write in that game's chat, and see your name
on it. A court booking's chat names its players, as the booking does; a clinic or social date's names only those
who've written in it. Someone who leaves a game reads what was said before they left; someone taken off it reads
nothing. The club's staff can read every chat, hide a message and stop someone posting; a message someone reported
keeps its words for the staff until they've looked at it, even if its author takes it back. Juniors don't see
chats.] Nothing about members is on the club's public page. Children are never on
the public page, in level lists or on leaderboards.

**Companies that help us run the club's app**, each only for what it does:

| Company | What for | What it gets |
|---|---|---|
| Stripe | Card payments | Your name and email, the amounts and what they're for, and your card, which you give to Stripe directly. Stripe keeps its own records, under its own privacy policy |
| Resend | Email | Your email address and each email we send you |
| Twilio [IF THE CLUB TEXTS] | Texts | Your mobile number, each text we send you, and what you text back |
| Apple, Google or Mozilla | Notifications, if you turn them on | Each notification, encrypted so only your device can read it |
| TypeSafe and Anthropic [IF THE CLUB USES "ASK THE CLUB"] | Matching your question to the club's own answers | The words of your question and the club's answers. We send no names, emails or numbers with it, so don't put personal details in a question you'd rather the club's staff read first. Under their terms, they may not use it to train AI models |
| [HOSTING PROVIDER OR "KUMI'S HOSTED SERVICE AND THE COMPANIES IT USES"] | Running the club's app and its backups | Everything the app holds. Backups are sealed before they leave the server, so the storage company can't read them |
| [PLAYTOMIC, IF THE CLUB USES IT] | Court bookings made on Playtomic | Nothing from the app: the club only reads its own Playtomic bookings into it, and keeps a copy of them (below) |

**Your own AI assistant.** If you connect an assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or another) to the club, it gets what you
ask it to read or do, under your own agreement with that company. You choose how much it may spend for you each
week, and you can disconnect it in the app at any time.

**When the law requires it**, or to protect someone's safety, we share what's needed and no more.

## How long we keep it

- While you're a member, and after, until you delete your account or ask us to [OR THE CLUB'S OWN RULE, SAY HOW
  LONG].
- When you delete your account (below), your name, email, phone and sign-ins go at once. We keep your payments,
  refunds, game results and levels, waiver acceptances and consent answers under "Former member", because our books
  and other players' levels need them.
- [IF THE CLUB HAS CHATS ON] A game's chat is deleted, with everything in it, 90 days after the game. A message
  you take back loses its words at once (unless someone reported it and the staff haven't looked yet). A notification
  about a chat keeps none of its words after it's shown. When you delete your account, your words in chats go too; the other players
  see "message removed".
- [IF THE CLUB USES PLAYTOMIC] We keep a copy of your bookings on Playtomic (court, time, price, whether it was paid,
  and the players in it by name and email), as our own record of the club's bookings. You see yours in your data
  download. When you delete your account here, your name and email go from that copy too; Playtomic's own number for
  you stays on it, without either, so they aren't copied back. If you join again later with the same address, what's
  yours from then on is kept like anyone's. Your Playtomic account itself is Playtomic's.
- Backups keep a copy for a while after: [BACKUP DAYS ON THE SERVER] days on the server, and up to
  [OFFSITE DAILY DAYS] days (monthly copies [OFFSITE MONTHLY MONTHS] months) offsite. *Note: with openPadel's defaults
  that's 14 days, 30 days and 12 months.* If we ever put a backup back, anything you deleted or took back since it
  was made (your account, a chat message, a sign-in, a no to messages) is deleted or taken back again, as long as
  the app can still read what it replaces. If it can't (the server it replaces was lost), we use the most recent
  backup's record of deleted accounts, and do by hand whatever that doesn't cover.

## Your choices

- **Download your data.** Profile, Your data, gives you a file of everything the club's app holds about you and the
  children you manage.
- **Delete your account.** Profile, Your data. If something is still running (a booking to come, a membership that
  renews, money owed), the app tells you what to clear first. Deleting a child only you manage deletes them too.
- **Change** your name, email or number in Profile. A change of email or number is checked with a code first, and
  your email (the old address, for an email change) hears about it, with a link to undo a change you didn't make.
- **Texts and club news:** turn them on or off in Profile, or reply STOP to a text, or use the link in a club news
  email.
- If you'd rather ask us, write to [CONTACT EMAIL]. The club hears of every download and deletion, and you hear when
  the club downloads your data for you.
- Depending on where you live, the law may give you more rights. [LAWYER: state-law rights, if they apply to the
  club.]

## Children

A child under 18 is a junior in a parent's family. A parent adds them with a name and birth year only: no email, no
number, no login. Parents sign them up, book and pay for them, and get their messages. A junior without a login
never appears on the public page, among friends or in open matches, and doesn't book courts.

From the year a child turns 13, a parent can give them a login of their own, with the child's email address. The
child can then book and join things themselves, paid on the family card within rules the parents set (what they
can book alone, and a monthly limit); anything else waits for a parent's yes. They stay off the public page, level
lists and leaderboards, and have no friends in the app unless a parent turns that on. Parents decide whether they
get texts, and can take the login away again.

We don't knowingly collect information directly from a child under 13. If you think we have, write to [CONTACT
EMAIL] and we'll delete it.

## Keeping it safe

Staff in the club's chosen roles sign in with two steps. Sign-ins use emailed or texted codes or passkeys, with
limits on how often anyone can try. The app only works over HTTPS. Backups are sealed with the club's own key.
No system is perfectly safe; if something goes wrong that affects your information, we tell you as the law
requires.

## Changes to this policy

We'll post the new version here with its date, and tell members in the app or by email before a change that
matters takes effect.
